chat.agent.description: SafeAppeals Agent for multi-step coding tasks with workspace tools
tool.readFile.modelDescription: Read the contents of a file in the workspace. Prefer this when you need file text before editing.
tool.listDir.modelDescription: List files and folders in a workspace directory.
tool.createFile.modelDescription: This is a tool for creating a new file in the workspace. The file will be created with the specified content. The directory will be created if it does not already exist. Never use this tool to edit a file that already exists.
tool.createDirectory.modelDescription: Create a new directory structure in the workspace. Will recursively create all directories in the path, like mkdir -p. You do not need to use this tool before using create_file, that tool will automatically create the needed directories.
tool.findFiles.modelDescription:
Search for files in the workspace by glob pattern. This only returns the paths of matching files. Use this tool when you know the exact filename pattern of the files you're searching for. Glob patterns match from the root of the workspace folder. Examples:
- **/*.{js,ts} to match all js/ts files in the workspace.
- src/** to match all files under the top-level src folder.
- **/foo/**/*.js to match all js files under any foo folder in the workspace.
tool.findFiles.userDescription: Search for files by glob pattern
tool.findTextInFiles.modelDescription: Do a fast text search in the workspace. Use this tool when you want to search with an exact string or regex. Use includePattern to search within files matching a specific pattern. Results are capped.
tool.searchWorkspaceSymbols.modelDescrip: Search the user's workspace for code symbols using language services. Use this tool when the user is looking for a specific symbol in their workspace.
tool.getErrors.modelDescription: Get any compile or lint errors in a specific file or across all files. If the user mentions errors or problems in a file, they may be referring to these. If the user asks you to analyze all errors, or does not specify a file, use this tool to gather errors for all files. Also use this tool after editing a file to validate the change.
tool.getChangedFiles.modelDescription: Get git-changed files in a git repository via the vscode.git extension API. Don't forget that you can use run_in_terminal to run git commands in a terminal as well.
tool.searchCodebase.modelDescription: Search the workspace codebase for relevant code using enhanced text search over query tokens. Returns path and snippet matches. This does not use a Copilot semantic index.
tool.replaceString.modelDescription: Replace exactly one occurrence of a literal string in an existing workspace file. Provide filePath, oldString (exact match including whitespace), and newString. Fails if oldString matches zero or multiple times.
tool.replaceString.userDescription: Replace one exact string in a file
tool.multiReplaceString.modelDescription: Apply multiple exact one-occurrence string replacements in a single call. Each replacement has filePath, oldString, and newString. Replacements are applied sequentially.
tool.applyPatch.modelDescription: Apply a V4A-lite / unified-diff-style patch to workspace files. Pass an "input" string wrapped in *** Begin Patch / *** End Patch with *** Add File, *** Update File, or *** Delete File sections and @@ hunks using space/-/+ line prefixes.
tool.applyPatch.userDescription: Apply a patch to workspace files
tool.runVscodeCommand.modelDescription: Run a VS Code command via executeCommand. Commands with known-safe prefixes run directly; others require user confirmation.
tool.fetchWebPage.modelDescription: Fetch the main content from one or more web pages as raw extracted text for you to read. Prefer this when you need the full page body for a specific URL. Optional maxLength clamps extracted text (1000–200000 chars). There is no AI summary — you must read the returned text yourself.
tool.fetchWebPage.userDescription: Fetch content from a web page
tool.webSearch.modelDescription: Search the web via SafeAppeals Cloud (Brave Search). Returns ranked titles, URLs, snippets, and optional metadata (Published/Domain/extra snippets) for YOU the agent to read — there is no AI summary. Ideal for general queries, news, articles, and recent events. Optional filters: safesearch, freshness (pd|pw|pm|py or past_day|…), country, search_lang, ui_lang, site. Optional autoFetch (1–5) fetches raw full page text for the top N result URLs. Credits apply (~250 per search). Maximum 20 results; use offset for pagination.
tool.webSearch.userDescription: Search the web through SafeAppeals Cloud (credits apply)
tool.multiWebSearch.modelDescription: Run multiple sequential web searches via SafeAppeals Cloud (Brave Search). Returns ranked titles, URLs, and snippets for YOU the agent to read — there is no AI summary. Ideal for batch information gathering. Optional filters apply to every query: safesearch, freshness, country, search_lang, ui_lang, site. Credits apply (~250 per query). Maximum 10 queries, 20 results per query.
tool.multiWebSearch.userDescription: Run multiple web searches through SafeAppeals Cloud (credits apply)

config.debug.apiUrl.description: Dev-only override for the SafeAppeals Cloud API base URL. Honored only when running a development build (`VSCODE_DEV`); production always uses `https://api.safeappeals.com`. Machine-scoped so Settings Sync never uploads it. Prefer the `SAFEAPPEALS_CLOUD_API_URL` environment variable when both are set.
config.dashboardUrl.description: Base URL for the SafeAppeals dashboard (finish page and paste fallback).
config.webCallbackOrigins.description: Allowed origins for automatic web OAuth callbacks via asExternalUri. Origins not in this list fall back to the finish-page paste flow.
